description: This file defines the NotificationDriver interface, which specifies methods for managing notification channels, building notifications, requesting permissions, and canceling notifications within the app.

classes.name: NotificationDriver
classes.description: An interface that defines methods for notification management, including initialization, building, permission requests, and cancellation.

methods.name: initializeChannels
methods.description: Initializes notification channels, possibly with different configurations for production environments.

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Constructs a notification with specified ID, icon, and title.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Displays the notification built by buildNotification, with an option to skip if permissions are not granted.

methods.name: askForNotificationPostPermission
methods.description: Requests permission to post notifications, for either an Activity or a Fragment.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels a notification with the given NotificationIds.
